text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

translations.asad: HAST THOU ever considered [the kind of man] who gives the lie to all moral law?
translations.sahih: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

translations.asad: Behold, it is this [kind of man] that thrusts the orphan away,
translations.sahih: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

translations.asad: and feels no urge to feed the needy.
translations.sahih: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

translations.asad: Woe, then, unto those praying ones
translations.sahih: So woe to those who pray

translations.asad: whose hearts from their prayer are remote
translations.sahih: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -

translations.asad: those who want only to be seen and praised,
translations.sahih: Those who make show [of their deeds]

translations.asad: and, withal, deny all assistance [to their fellow-men]!
